email.subject: Quick fix for Pistons Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Aisha,

I checked Pistons Auto Care's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not set up for mobile, and there's no click-to-call button, so anyone searching for an auto shop in Harbor Falls on their phone can't easily reach you. The site also has heavy images that slow load time and a footer with outdated info.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Happy to walk you through what I found, free, in 10 minutes, no obligation.

Would this week work?

Alex
Northlight Web
